candidates.brief: Quest's small apartment living room by day: sofa, rug, plants, window light. Lived-in but tidy enough to read. Floor space left-centre.
Apartment facades at dusk with clean window grid; no malformed vehicles/people.
Old-fashioned bank loan office: heavy desk front-centre, tall paper stacks, filing cabinets, framed rules on wall (no readable text). Warm, slightly oppressive light. Desk surface empty for props.
SAME framing, tall golden wheat ready to harvest, late-afternoon light.
Mid-shot farm field, rows receding to a distant treeline and barn, soil freshly plowed, bright morning. Horizon at ~40 %. Rows lead the eye centre.
Farm workshop/shed: workbench, tools on pegboard, oil stains, warm work light, open space centre for a broken tractor prop.
Busy city street in a jam: car rows, taillights, billboards WITHOUT readable text, late-afternoon haze. Seen from driver height.
SAME framing as home_living_day, at night: lamp light, blue window, a desk corner with a router on the right shelf area left EMPTY (router is a prop).
